name: manage_scratchpad
description: Compose, edit, and deliver text content. Use for any multi-line content: emails, documents, descriptions. Compose in the scratchpad, edit by line or JSON path, attach files, then send to any target. For short one-liners, use the service tool directly instead.

operation.description: create: new buffer | view: show content | discard: free buffer | list: show all | insert_lines/append_lines/replace_lines/remove_lines: line editing | copy_lines: copy from another scratchpad | json_get/json_set/json_delete/json_insert: path-addressed JSON editing | attach/detach: file references | import: load from Google Workspace resource | send: deliver to target

scratchpadId.description: Scratchpad ID (sp-XXXX). Required for all operations except create and list.

format.description: For create: content format (default: text). Controls validation and addressing mode.

content.description: Text content. For create (pre-fill), insert_lines, append_lines, replace_lines.

afterLine.description: Insert after this line number (0 = prepend). For insert_lines, copy_lines, attach.

startLine.description: Start of line range (1-based). For replace_lines, remove_lines, copy_lines, view.

endLine.description: End of line range (inclusive). For replace_lines, remove_lines, copy_lines, view.

value.description: For json_set, json_insert: value to set or insert (any JSON type)

source.description: For attach: file source (workspace or drive). For import: resource type (doc, email, sheet, drive_file).

filename.description: For attach (workspace source): filename in workspace

fileId.description: For attach (drive source): Drive file ID

refId.description: For detach: attachment reference ID (att-1, att-2, etc.)

sourceParams.description: For import: source-specific parameters (e.g., { documentId, mode } for doc, { messageId } for email)

targetParams.description: For send: target-specific parameters (e.g., { email, to, subject } for email, { filename } for workspace)

keep.description: For send: keep scratchpad after successful send (default: true)
